verdicts.reason: A is unusable. The SALE letters are pulled out of their circles and scattered as "E" above the headline and "S A L" below it, so the word is broken and out of order. The lantern circles are shrunk to a tiny cluster in the bottom-left corner, the headline floats in the middle, and decoration fills the top half while the bottom is dead space. B at least keeps a large headline at the top and the lantern-circle motif. But its SALE letters are also broken: "A" and "L" are jammed into one circle, the third circle is empty, and the "E" spills across a circle edge. The circles are also cut close to the right edge of the canvas, and the decoration is duplicated awkwardly down the left side, so B is clearly broken too, just less badly than A.
